title: Package pickup
passage:
Where can I collect the package if I miss the delivery?
A. At the service counter on Pine Street.
B. It arrived earlier than usual.
C. The package requires a signature.
passageZh:
如果錯過配送，我可以在哪裡領包裹？
A. 到 Pine 街的服務櫃檯。
B. 它比平常早到。
C. 這件包裹需要簽收。
